caveats: Mason's tempo comes from ~30 fps video (downswing 4-6 frames); treat as a loose band only (+-~27%).
Club speed is unavailable from video; the 120 mph value is self-reported and unverified.
Mason's joint features are 2-D proxies and have no counterpart in published profile stats, so they are NOT compared.
band_position is position inside a plausibility band (0.5 = target), not a population percentile.
Profiles are style profiles from published numbers (some unverified); not simulations of real persons. Internal reference only; counsel review before any external use.
Priority ranks where a gap is both large relative to noise and trustworthy; it is not a coaching prescription. Consult a coach/fitter.

backswing_s.note: absolute durations from edited/possibly sped-up feed clips are unreliable (0.48 s would be extraordinarily fast); trust the ratio more than the seconds

club_head_speed_mph.note: SELF-REPORTED (120+ mph), not measured; video cannot measure club speed

downswing_s.note: likely under-detected (4-6 frames); slow-mo clips suggest ~0.17-0.23 s true; treat as suspect

tempo_ratio.note: ~30 fps screen recordings; downswing only 4-6 frames; per-swing rel. uncertainty ~27%

measure_next.what: Launch-monitor club/ball speed, smash, launch, spin, attack angle (one 20-shot session)
240 fps down-the-line + face-on video of 20+ driver swings to get a trustworthy tempo ratio and downswing time
3-D/markerless pelvis & thorax turn and X-factor at top (needs face-on 120+ fps or 3-D capture)
Pelvis/thorax/arm peak angular speeds and their order (kinematic sequence)
Stance width, ball position, shaft lean at address (a still face-on and DTL photo with a club on the ground works)
